acceptance.text: Produce an architecture plan for $wf-ui covering backend server, frontend app, task capsule API, PTY terminal bridge, settings, and security boundaries.
Define the first implementable MVP slice with file locations, dependency strategy, validation commands, and rollback boundaries.
Decide whether $wf-ui is a command, skill, script, or combined command+skill surface, and list all mirrors/templates/tests that must be updated.
Keep task capsule file state as the durable source of truth; UI state must be derived or explicitly synchronized.
Record observability limits for cross-runtime peer agents and their nested subagents.
